prompt:
Fix snippets/pickup-availability.liquid so it renders a deduplicated pickup availability list. Inputs (all top-level): - `locations`: array, never null, may be empty. Each item has `name` (string, never null; after stripping it is non-empty and never contains the character `|`), `available` (boolean) and `pickup_time` (string or null). - `max_shown`: integer, at least 1. Rules. Walk `locations` in the given order: 1. Ignore every location whose `available` is false. Ignored locations have no effect at all: they are not listed, not counted and do not mark a name as seen. 2. Compare names after stripping leading and trailing whitespace. An available location whose stripped name exactly matches (case-sensitive, whole name only, not a substring) the stripped name of an earlier available location is a duplicate. Ignore it completely, whether or not the earlier one was listed. 3. The first `max_shown` distinct available locations are listed. Every further distinct available location is counted as hidden. 4. The time text is `pickup_time` stripped. If `pickup_time` is null, empty or whitespace-only, use `Usually ready in 24 hours` instead. Output, with no whitespace or newlines between or around elements: - If no location is listed: `

No pickup locations available

` - Otherwise: `
    ` + items + `
`. Each item is `
  • NAME: TIME
    • `, where NAME is the stripped name, HTML-escaped, and TIME is the time text, HTML-escaped. The first listed item is `
  • NAME: TIME
    • `. This is the first item actually listed, which need not be at the first array index. If the hidden count N is greater than 0, the `` is immediately followed by `

    +N more

    `. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/pickup-availability.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
